coverageNotes: Source distribution links were verified on official GitHub repositories; no SaaS uptime, prices, subscription plans or hands-on results are claimed.
Coverage favors tools with accessible primary evidence. HR, ecommerce, CRM, paid assistants and other underserved categories remain research gaps, not empty published categories.
